page.notes: Marginal notes transcribed: "Quinque loca." (left-hand margin note beside "Quinque loca," in the right margin with "Rom. 8. v. 28." below it) and "Chrysostomus." beside the Greek passage. Greek text is transcribed as best read; accents on the second Chrysostom quotation are uncertain and may contain errors. The final line "Non" is a catchword-like word at the foot of the text and is printed in italic; it is retained in main text. The word "præuisione" and the Greek word after it are partly illegible on the scan; the Greek θεοῦ is a best reading [?]. Some marginal and Greek characters are uncertain throughout.
